outcomeNote: objection answered by restricting the baraita

segments.he: אֵיתִיבֵיהּ רָבָא לְרַב נַחְמָן: עַד אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשִּׁים זוּז! אָמַר לֵיהּ: כִּי תַּנְיָא הָהִיא – שֶׁבָּאתָה חֲבִילָה לְיָדוֹ.
segments.en: «Rava raised an objection to Rav Naḥman:» But it was taught in a baraita that he can hire at their expense for «up to forty or fifty dinars.» Rav Naḥman «said to him: When that» baraita «is taught» it is with regard to a case «where the bundle has come into his possession,» i.e., the original worker left his tool kit with the employer. In this situation, the employer has more financial leverage, as he can sell the contents of the bundle to cover even higher costs.
